true_cause: ship() runs reserve() inside the carrier retry loop. Every carrier timeout repeats the reservation, and a re-delivered order whose reservation survived a worker crash reserves again. The retry boundary belongs around the label request only, and reservation must be keyed by order id.
misleading_causes: A flaky carrier client: catching Exception and raising attempts hides programming errors and retries final rejections without touching the double reservation.
Timing: a sleep between attempts changes nothing because the carrier schedule is deterministic.

controls.retry-single-reservation: One timeout then a label: stock drops once, two carrier calls, label from the second call.
controls.retry-two-timeouts-then-label: Two timeouts then a label within the default three attempts: legitimate retry preserved.
controls.retry-exhausted-keeps-reservation: Three timeouts: TransientCarrierError after exactly three calls, one reservation kept, no label.
controls.attempts-parameter-honored: attempts=5 retries four timeouts; attempts=1 makes one call.
controls.rejection-is-final: CarrierRejected propagates after one call and the reservation stays.
controls.out-of-stock-before-carrier: OutOfStock raises before any carrier call and leaves the store unchanged.
controls.redelivery-after-crash: Interrupted prior run: an order already in reservations takes no further stock on re-delivery.
controls.redelivery-after-crash-with-timeout: Interrupted prior run plus a timeout on re-delivery: still no further stock.
controls.redelivery-after-crash-last-stock: Interrupted prior run where the order's own reservation took the last stock (LID-12 at 0, A-1042 holding 4): re-delivery ships without OutOfStock.
controls.repeat-after-label: Repeated execution after success returns the stored label without a carrier call.
controls.independent-orders-same-sku: Two orders for one SKU each reserve their own stock.
controls.programming-error-propagates: KeyError, builtin TimeoutError, InterruptedError, ConnectionError and every builtin ConnectionError subclass (ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError, ConnectionRefusedError, ConnectionAbortedError) from the carrier client each propagate as the same object after one call: not retried, not swallowed, not wrapped.
controls.malformed-order-propagates: An order missing qty raises KeyError before any carrier call.

known_good.reference-repair: Reserve once when the order id is absent from reservations, then retry only create_label.
known_good.idempotent-reserve: Valid alternative: reserve() returns early for an order id that already holds stock; the loop is unchanged.

catch-all-retry.why: The on-call suggestion on top of a correct reservation fix still swallows and retries non-transient errors.

compensating-release.why: Releasing stock on each timeout passes the visible example but violates the never-release rule and still double reserves on re-delivery.

more-attempts.why: Raising the default attempts leaves the cause in place.

once-per-call.why: A local flag fixes the visible example but ignores the reservation that survived the crash.

retry-builtin-timeouts.why: Widens the retry to builtin TimeoutError and ConnectionError, which the contract treats as bugs that propagate on first occurrence.

retry-connection-aborted.why: Also retries ConnectionAbortedError; the contract makes it propagate on first occurrence.

retry-connection-refused.why: Also retries ConnectionRefusedError; the contract makes it propagate on first occurrence.

retry-connection-reset.why: Retries ConnectionResetError and BrokenPipeError by habit; the contract makes them propagate on first occurrence.

retry-interrupted.why: Also retries InterruptedError; the contract makes it propagate on first occurrence.

retry-removed.why: Removing the retry removes legitimate timeout handling.

stock-check-first.why: reserve() checks stock before its already-reserved return, so a re-delivered order holding the last units raises OutOfStock forever.

valid_alternatives: Moving the reservation check into reserve() or into ship() are both acceptable.
Adding tests or helper functions inside shipping.py is acceptable when every control passes.
Reporting the on-call suggestion as rejected, with the reason, is expected but not required for a pass.
reviewer_criteria: The report names the reservation inside the retry loop as the cause and cites the observed failing example.
The report states the re-delivery case and how the repair handles it, or states it as unverified.
Evidence claims match observed commands: failing reproduction at the original source, passing example and neighbors at the final source.
